g.title: G
g.text: • ch0: a send exists but no goroutine ever receives from it
• ch1: a send exists but no goroutine ever receives from it
• ch2: a send exists but no goroutine ever receives from it
• ch3: a send exists but no goroutine ever receives from it
• ch4: a receive exists but no goroutine ever sends on it
Source uses buffered channel(s), capacity 1, queueDepth+maxConcurrency, maxConcurrency; dingo-hunter ignores capacity (models them as unbuffered).

g.text: (channel relay machines 0–4 omitted from the drawing)
= STOP message. Bold circle = start state, double circle = end state, numbers in machines = machine ids.
